command_input.cmd:
zsh -c 'set -eu; before_prices=$(cksum inputs/prices.txt); before_subtotal=$(cksum output/subtotal.txt); printf "fingerprint_before_prices=%s
" "$before_prices"; printf "fingerprint_before_subtotal=%s
" "$before_subtotal"; sum=0; while IFS= read -r price || [ -n "$price" ]; do case "$price" in (""|*[!0-9-]*) exit 20;; esac; sum=$((sum + price)); done < inputs/prices.txt; expected=$(printf "%s
" "$sum" | od -An -t x1 | tr -d " 
"); actual=$(od -An -t x1 output/subtotal.txt | tr -d " 
"); [ "$actual" = "$expected" ]; after_prices=$(cksum inputs/prices.txt); after_subtotal=$(cksum output/subtotal.txt); printf "fingerprint_after_prices=%s
" "$after_prices"; printf "fingerprint_after_subtotal=%s
" "$after_subtotal"; [ "$before_prices" = "$after_prices" ]; [ "$before_subtotal" = "$after_subtotal" ]'

command_result.merged_output:
fingerprint_before_prices=2869352896 9 inputs/prices.txt
fingerprint_before_subtotal=596333413 3 output/subtotal.txt
fingerprint_after_prices=2869352896 9 inputs/prices.txt
fingerprint_after_subtotal=596333413 3 output/subtotal.txt
